The '''conquest of Saijo''' was fought in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] during the [[Nagai–Tof War]]. In the battle, [[Tof Kingdom]] forces easily took control of [[Saijo/Legends|Saijo]] from the [[Nagai expeditionary force]], who were now allied with the recently formed [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Forgotten War" />
